name: De-vig sum-to-one holds across multiple sampled matches
description: The de-vig invariant must hold for the whole tournament, not just one match. Sampling several distinct matches guards against a build that hard-codes correct math for one fixture and ships broken or placeholder odds for the rest.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /api/matches and read the ids of at least four distinct matches from different rounds
For each captured id, navigate to /match-odds/<id>.json and read every book's devigged.home, devigged.draw and devigged.away

Verify that across all sampled matches every book's de-vigged probabilities sum to 1.0 within plus or minus 0.001, and that the decimal odds differ between matches (not the same repeated placeholder line). A match whose odds are missing, zero, or identical to another match's fails.
